profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at PubMatic
profile.summary: Results-oriented, customer-centric, and analytically adept Senior Software Engineer with a penchant for innovative problem-solving. Proficient in Database Management, Algorithmic Design, and Data Structures, showcasing over 4 years of comprehensive experience in end-to-end Hadoop solutions. Demonstrated ability to thrive in high-pressure, fast-paced environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Redwood City, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.description:
• Designed, developed and maintained a web based online portal and video recording
system.
• Recorded online lectures to enable distant learning for remote students across the
globe.
• Configured, troubleshoot and maintained consoles for recording and uploading
lectures to the university portal.
• Assisted students and faculty in identifying, diagnosing and resolving software or
hardware related issue.

positions.title: Android Developer, Software Developer
positions.description:
Performed diverse roles in application design including development, documentation, requirements analysis and testing of the application.
- Participated in code merge, code review and testing and application in different Android operating systems.
- Released both android applications biweekly on the Google Play Store with frequent updates.
- Integrated RESTful API to sync application data with the cloud database.
- Created RESTful API to store, search, update, delete data in cloud database using a Node.js express framework.
- Diagnosed and resolved technical issues that occurred at the application sites.
- Managed tasks with Agile framework and methodologies.
- Solved complex problems with the use of advanced data structures and object-oriented design patterns.

projects.title: Stock Watch
projects.description:
Developed an Android application as a technical task for University event.
- Used RESTful APIs to gather stock data from Internet and inserted that JSON data into SQLite Database.
- Deployed a User Interface that can be easily operated by Users.
- Implemented multiple AsyncTasks, RecyclerView for better performance.

projects.title: Dashboard with UML
projects.description:
Developed a dynamic dashboard using object-oriented design patterns.
- Deployed an interactive dashboard for filtering. Using this the user can select any data set and can select columns,
rows and data will be displayed in charts.
- Used ECMA script to implement classes and design patterns in JavaScript.
